propositions: The enrich drain gate check is O(ticket count) because pending_enrichment walks every ticket dir and calls reduce_ticket three times per ticket, costing ~24,000 filesystem metadata syscalls per gate check against a 20 ms budget.

Every rebar write on a real store triggers the drain gate through maybe_drain when verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets is enabled, adding 486–740 ms of latency on a 4,710-ticket store, causing a ~25x budget overrun and positive-feedback contention when multiple agents write concurrently.

The budget-breach warning fires on 100% of writes in large stores, rendering it noise and masking genuine future breaches; the actual problem is vnode cache saturation under concurrent metadata ops from multiple simultaneous gate checks.

The fix implements an O(1) marker file .rebar/enrich-gate.json recording the next instant any queue entry becomes pending, allowing pending_enrichment to return [] immediately for quiet stores and invalidating the marker only on queue mutations via _append.

Self-healing mechanisms ensure a lost, corrupt, or stale marker degrades to a full scan (never a missed drain), the marker expires after 10 minutes (well inside the 60-minute soak window), and marker writes are atomic.
